mapper.select: SELECT A.review_id AS "reviewId" , A.review_status AS "reviewStatus" , COALESCE(B.name, A.reviewer_emp_id) AS "reviewerName" , TO_CHAR(A.review_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "reviewDate" , TO_CHAR(A.request_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "requestDate" , A.developer_name AS "developerName" , TO_CHAR(A.dev_completed_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "devCompletedDate" FROM tb_screen_review A LEFT JOIN employees B ON B.id = A.reviewer_emp_id WHERE A.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND A.menu_id = #{menuId}

SELECT review_id AS "reviewId" , review_status AS "reviewStatus" , TO_CHAR(request_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "requestDate" FROM tb_screen_review WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND menu_id = #{menuId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_screen_review (tenant_id, menu_id, review_status, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{menuId}, 'NOT_STARTED', #{empId}, #{empId}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, menu_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_screen_review_history (tenant_id, review_id, from_status, to_status, review_comment, reviewer_emp_id, review_date, request_no) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{reviewId}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{reviewComment}, #{empId}, CAST(#{reviewDate} AS date), #{requestNo, jdbcType=INTEGER}) RETURNING history_id

SELECT A.history_id AS "historyId" , A.from_status AS "fromStatus" , A.to_status AS "toStatus" , A.review_comment AS "reviewComment" , COALESCE(B.name, A.reviewer_emp_id) AS "reviewerName" , TO_CHAR(A.review_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "reviewDate" , TO_CHAR(A.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createdAt" , A.request_no AS "requestNo" FROM tb_screen_review_history A LEFT JOIN employees B ON B.id = A.reviewer_emp_id WHERE A.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND A.review_id = #{reviewId} ORDER BY A.history_id DESC

INSERT INTO tb_screen_review_draft (tenant_id, menu_id, writer_emp_id, review_comment) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{menuId}, #{empId}, #{reviewComment}) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, menu_id, writer_emp_id) DO UPDATE SET review_comment = EXCLUDED.review_comment , updated_at = now() RETURNING draft_id

SELECT file_id AS "fileId" , owner_id AS "ownerId" , file_name AS "fileName" , file_size AS "fileSize" FROM tb_common_file WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND owner_type = #{ownerType} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND owner_id IN #{ownerId} ORDER BY owner_id, file_id
